p: Denver will keep attacking deep, with Franklin on the field in Delta go packages.
Franklin was on the field for the repeated Delta go shot that drew a pass interference penalty, which is useful for his big-play upside.
Mims and Troy came on and we ran Delta go again.
Franklin will keep a role in a deep WR group, with snaps likely to shrink when Bryant returns.
Payton lumped Franklin into a deep group rather than singling him out, so his increased snaps are not guaranteed to continue.
we've got really good depth there. We've drafted well there.
